sections.thesis: Longer-term Treasury yields rose while short-term yields fell after the Fed held rates steady, a sign of some concern the Fed may be too complacent on inflation.

sentences.text: Longer-term Treasury yields rose while short-term yields fell after the Fed held rates steady, a sign of some concern the Fed may be too complacent on inflation.
The vote was 10-2 to hold the benchmark in the 3.75%-4% range, with Lisa Cook joining Beth Hammack in dissent.
Futures show a roughly 85% chance of a December hike, and the 10-year yield hovered just above 5%, up from 4.992% Tuesday.

sections.thesis: The dollar index held above 102.00 near a two-week high, as oil-driven inflation concerns keep Fed hike bets on the table.

sentences.text: The dollar index held above 102.00 near a two-week high, as oil-driven inflation concerns keep Fed hike bets on the table.
Geopolitical uncertainty also supports the dollar, as US officials tell regional allies to prepare for a possible campaign against Iran after the November 3 midterms.

sections.thesis: Alphabet shares plunged 8% after revenue and earnings missed estimates, as AI cuts into search and ad revenue.

sentences.text: Alphabet shares plunged 8% after revenue and earnings missed estimates, as AI cuts into search and ad revenue.
Google Cloud revenue of $30.71 billion beat the $29.1 billion estimate, but free cash flow was negative for a second straight quarter.
Earlier the S&P 500 and Nasdaq composite each rose 0.3% on Warsh's tone, and Microsoft rose in late trading on a revenue beat.

sections.thesis: Brent is around $110 a barrel despite rebounding Gulf exports, on fears of renewed escalation, thin stockpiles and costly shipping.

sentences.text: Brent is around $110 a barrel despite rebounding Gulf exports, on fears of renewed escalation, thin stockpiles and costly shipping.
